children: Midnight plans to add cross-chain wallet access in Q1 2027. The feature will let users approve private transactions on Midnight from wallets they already use on other chains.

Users will not need to switch to a Midnight wallet to give that approval. For Midnight, this gives the network a more direct way to reach users on other chains and to access assets and liquidity from outside its own network.
💎 More Chains, Private - Expanding NightMode so more network ecosystems can use Midnight’s privacy infrastructure.
